corrections.after: வேண்டுமானால் நாங்கள் கொஞ்சம் ஒதுங்கி நிற்கிறோம், மாநில சுயாட்சி

refinements.before: Mr Kamaraj is an honoured leader who served as Chief Minister for more than eight years in a Government administration.
refinements.after: Mr Kamaraj is an honoured leader who served as Chief Minister for more than eight years in government.

refinements.before: He knew through whom incoming money is spent;
refinements.after: He knew through whom the money received by the Government is spent;

refinements.before: If the accounts are followed continuously from 1956-57, the proportion has grown at about the same level.
refinements.after: If we follow the accounts continuously from 1956-57, these proportions have remained at about the same level.

refinements.before: In the financial statement I have compiled and presented many useful schemes that show what we are implementing.
refinements.after: In the financial statement I have set out many useful schemes as evidence of what we are implementing.

refinements.before: She said, “Is this motorist the only person you find fault with for everything? Is the bus owner the only person you find? You have long been angry with them.”
refinements.after: She said, “For everything, is this motorist the only person you can find? Is the bus owner the only person you can find? You have long been angry with them.”

refinements.before: Even today, after Independence, ordinary Harijan people in villages not only lack proper paths on which to walk;
refinements.after: Even today, after Independence, Harijan people in ordinary villages not only lack proper paths on which to walk;

refinements.before: Four persons carry a body over a narrow single-foot path, slip and fall, and the body too falls into the field —
refinements.after: Four persons carry a body along a narrow single-file footpath, slip and fall, and the body too falls into the field —

refinements.before: our Mr K.T.K. Thangamani stopped with saying that they are distributed in Kerala.
refinements.after: our Mr K.T.K. Thangamani confined himself to saying that they are distributed in Kerala.

refinements.before: Thus we have acted without fear or favour and without discrimination.
refinements.after: Thus we have acted without leniency and without discrimination.

refinements.before: after forty days of bloodshed in Mudukulathur,
refinements.after: after forty days of violent conflict in Mudukulathur,

refinements.before: with haystacks set ablaze, houses set on fire, five or six men having their hands and eyes bound and being shot face-to-face at Keelathooval,
refinements.after: with haystacks set ablaze, houses set on fire, five or six men with their hands bound and eyes blindfolded being shot face-to-face at Keelathooval,

refinements.before: and those 23 bodies were brought out and displayed like fish laid out in a market — those responsible were Congressmen.
refinements.after: and those 23 bodies were brought out and displayed like fish laid out in a market — the people who displayed them were members of the Congress Party.

refinements.before: But I firmly believe that the true Tamil Kamaraj will not fall into Rajaji's net.
refinements.after: But I firmly believe that Kamaraj, a true Tamilian, will not fall into Rajaji's net.

refinements.before: Rajaji is in a hurry. His age is increasing.
refinements.after: Rajaji is in a hurry. He is getting older.

refinements.before: The reason was that those respective All India trade-union representatives withdrew their representatives.
refinements.after: The reason was that they withdrew the respective All India trade-union representatives.

refinements.before: Some clever people had reduced even their holdings to 25 acres or 20 acres.
refinements.after: Some clever people had kept their holdings down even to 25 acres or 20 acres.

refinements.before: They are not worried about four thousand going — not worried about the elephant going — but are worried that the cat may go.
refinements.after: They are not worried about four thousand acres going — not worried about the elephant going — but are worried that the cat may go.

refinements.before: Mr Mohan Kumaramangalam, elected from the Union Territory of Pondicherry and serving as a Minister in the Central Government, comes to Tamil Nadu and speaks at the party level.
refinements.after: Mr Mohan Kumaramangalam, elected from Puduvai and serving as a Minister in the Central Government, comes to Tamil Nadu and speaks at the party level.

refinements.before: They have been in the Congress Party for a long time. (Laughter.)
refinements.after: He is someone who has been in the Congress Party for a long time. (Laughter.)

refinements.before: when a Union Minister speaks in such a low manner about a financial statement presented by a State Minister.
refinements.after: when a Union Minister speaks in such a disparaging manner about a financial statement presented by a State Minister.

refinements.before: I do not know how many years he will remain involved and established in the Congress.
refinements.after: I do not know how many years he will remain in the Congress.

refinements.before: The Volga-Don river project has been completed to the extent of connecting Asiatic Russia and European Russia.
refinements.after: The Volga-Don river project has been completed, linking Asiatic Russia and European Russia.

refinements.before: Could it not instead be said that the Ganga-Cauvery linking project thereby strengthens national integration?
refinements.after: Could it not instead be said that the Ganga-Cauvery linking project thereby underscores national integration?
